switch field.DataType {
    case schemapb.DataType_Bool:
        nameColumns[field.Name] = append(nameColumns[field.Name].([]bool), candi.v.Interface().(bool))
    case schemapb.DataType_Int8:
        nameColumns[field.Name] = append(nameColumns[field.Name].([]int8), candi.v.Interface().(int8))
    case schemapb.DataType_Int16:
        nameColumns[field.Name] = append(nameColumns[field.Name].([]int16), candi.v.Interface().(int16))
    case schemapb.DataType_Int32:
        nameColumns[field.Name] = append(nameColumns[field.Name].([]int32), candi.v.Interface().(int32))
    case schemapb.DataType_Int64:
        nameColumns[field.Name] = append(nameColumns[field.Name].([]int64), candi.v.Interface().(int64))  // LINE 1954 - BUG: Direct type assertion, no string->int64 conversion
        // When JSON contains {"id": "100"}, candi.v holds a string, not int64
        // This line should validate and convert string to int64 or reject with type error

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 Upsert → checkAndSetData(body) → gjson.GetBytes parses JSON → anyToColumns(rows, schema) → line 1954 does candi.v.Interface().(int64) direct type assertion

verdicts.rationale: Milvus REST v2 upsert endpoint接受不匹配的primary key类型(字符串'100'替代Int64 100),违反契约类型安全要求。源码接地发现line 1954处直接类型断言candi.v.Interface().(int64)缺少类型校验,当传入字符串时应返回类型错误而非静默转换。实测复现证实服务端返回HTTP 200成功,query验证确认数据已接受,构成真缺陷。此缺陷命中开发者认知的REST v2类型处理盲点模式,历史issues显示该层存在系统性类型处理问题。
